description: Low-level 3-way in-core file merge implementation for Git, including built-in and external merge drivers, attribute handling, and merge result processing.

methods.name: load_merge_attributes
methods.description: Initializes merge attribute checks, particularly conflict marker size.

methods.name: reset_merge_attributes
methods.description: Frees and resets merge attribute checks.

methods.name: ll_binary_merge
methods.description: Performs a built-in binary merge, choosing source based on options.

methods.name: ll_xdl_merge
methods.description: Performs a text-based merge using xdl if files are suitable, otherwise falls back to binary merge.

methods.name: ll_union_merge
methods.description: Performs a union merge favoring union.

methods.name: create_temp
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with the contents of a given mmfile.

methods.name: ll_ext_merge
methods.description: Handles external merge driver invocation via command line.

methods.name: read_merge_config
methods.description: Reads merge driver configuration from git config.

methods.name: find_ll_merge_driver
methods.description: Finds the appropriate merge driver based on attribute or configuration.

methods.name: ll_merge
methods.description: Main function to perform a merge using the selected driver.
